newsitem.title: USA: iMALL hires advisor for financial options.
newsitem.headline: iMALL hires advisor for financial options.

text.p: iMALL Inc said Friday it has retained Geller & Friend Capital Partners Inc, a Los Angeles-based merchant bank, as investment advisors.

The company said the advisor, which specializes in serving the needs of middle market growth companies, has been engaged to assist iMALL with the development and implementation of long-term financial strategies and in identifying and evaluating potential growth opportunities.
The company said one of Geller & Friend's initial undertakings will be an assessment of iMALL's capital structure and the various options available to the company.

The company also said it decided, prior to the engagement of Geller & Friend, not to proceed with a proposed, previously-announced institutional private placement of $4.8 million and the simultaneous recontribution by the three founders of a total of 8.1 million common shares.
